name: Pallium India
summary: Provides palliative care in Kerala and works with Indian states to expand pain relief and opioid access for people with serious illness.

spending.source: https://palliumindia.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/Annual-Report-2024-2025-1.pdf (p.34, consolidated income and expenditure FY2024-25 in INR lakhs: hospital and patient aid 146.41 + training and advocacy 51.82 + project expenses 700.51 = 898.74 of 1,087.24 total, the rest being other expenses 167.57 and depreciation 20.93; converted at 0.011831 USD per INR, average of ECB daily reference rates Apr 2024-Mar 2025 via api.frankfurter.dev)
